title: Organization-Based Team Outcome Study in Rehabilitation Care: A Multicenter, Multilevel Study of Organizational Structural and Process Characteristics, Quality of Care, Patient Satisfaction, and Treatment Outcomes (ORTEO Study)
summary: The study examines the extent to which the quality of care and collaboration within the rehabilitation team as well as certain structural features influence patient satisfaction and treatment outcomes from the patients' perspective
conditions: The survey of rehabilitation patients is an ongoing survey conducted in approximately 30 clinics covering all common primary indications (orthopedics, cardiology, oncology, psychosomatics, etc.)

interventions.name: Based on the patient survey that GfQG has been conducting continuously since 2005, the approximately 80 participating clinics were invited to take part in the study; so far, 30 clinics (54 specialized departments) have agreed to participate. Negotiations are currently underway with approximately 10

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
all patients undergoing inpatient rehabilitation
Exclusion criteria:
patients undergoing outpatient rehabilitation at the participating clinics
sponsor: GfQG Gesellschaft für Qualität im Gesundheitswesen
